## Phases 10-19 (2026-10-08)
- **DASH-BR-045** - RESOLVED 2026-10-10 (dashboard-side): the BFF and client now accept `scope:slug` segments; custom pages are listed, created from the workspace and opened (verified live). Original ask: allow `:` in the BFF path allowlist or expose custom web page keys with a URL-safe alias so `custom:<slug>` pages can be edited.
- **DASH-BR-046** - RESOLVED 2026-10-10: `backend/packages/commerce-domain/scripts/gen-doc-schemas.ts` generates all seven document schemas from the validators into `docs/backend-contract/doc-schemas.json`; `tests/unit/studio/doc-schema-drift.test.ts` fails if the Studio forms and the backend drift apart. Content-library entity schemas are still hand mirrors. Original ask: publish JSON Schemas for tokens/navigation/chrome documents (blocks.schema.json says "not representable") and for content-library entities.
- **DASH-BR-047** - RESOLVED 2026-10-10 for discard: `POST /experience/:channel/docs/:kind/:key/discard-draft` (If-Match + reason) returns a draft to the live version as a new revision; the editor has "Return to live version" (verified live). Deleting standard pages stays refused by design. Original ask: allow deleting/resetting standard Studio pages (DELETE returns 409 ILLEGAL_STATE) and add an If-Match-protected "discard draft".
- **DASH-BR-048** - Return the `ETag` header through the gateway (the BFF forwards content headers only; the dashboard uses the body `etag`).
- **DASH-BR-049** - Document or raise the admin write rate limit (429 during the 34-block round trip).

- **DASH-BR-050** - Document the public catalogue cache TTL, or invalidate it on archive/deactivate, so a hidden product disappears immediately.

- **DASH-BR-051** - **Experience app page block placement is not represented in the published bundle contract.** The public `pages.category`, `pages.product`, and `pages.cart` shape has `blocks` and `nativeSections`, but there is no typed way to say whether a block belongs before or after native catalog/product/cart content. The Flutter app currently renders published page blocks before native content and honours `nativeSections` visibility; this is deterministic but prevents an operator from placing a testimonial, trust strip, or FAQ after related products without client-specific inference. **Requested contract:** add an optional, backwards-compatible `placement: "beforeNative" | "afterNative"` to app page blocks (default `beforeNative`), and document it in `blocks.schema.json`, OpenAPI, and the Experience Studio form. The safe app fallback remains current ordering for documents without `placement`.
